<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD follows standard AUR packaging practices for an AppImage-based package. The source is downloaded from the project's own upstream domain (software.echoed.gg) with a pinned sha256sum. The `prepare()` function uses `unshare -n -r` for network-isolated extraction, which is a security-conscious approach. The wrapper script sets `LD_PRELOAD` to `/usr/lib/libwayland-client.so`, which is a known workaround for AppImages running under Wayland compositors — it loads a legitimate system library, not arbitrary code. All file operations (installing to `/opt/`, creating symlinks in `/usr/bin/`, installing desktop files and icons) are routine packaging steps. No suspicious network calls, obfuscated code, or data exfiltration vectors were found.
</details>
